message:
docs(field-test): say why the missing retries and the three write sites matter

Two observations were already recorded but undersold.

The first is that there are only four [abr] lines in the whole window and none
after 17:56:08. That is the shape of the user's complaint: the controller has
nothing left to raise, having already reached high at 12 Mbps, while the
encode sits at 720p -- and the log shows no attempt after that. Stated as the
observation it is, not as a proof that recovery is impossible.

The second is that encodeSourceW is written in exactly three places. Since it
is the basis every fit is measured against, those three are the whole surface;
one runs once at startup and one refuses to skip the correction, which leaves
a single path that can lower it unnoticed. That closes off "something else
might have changed it" at the code level -- though not the question of which
path actually ran, since nothing observes the variable at runtime.

No measurement changed, no cause claimed, no limit weakened. Documentation
only, working from the excerpts already preserved -- the NAS was not queried
again.
